data.name: Wispy Form
data.description: The wind listener gains the ability to become airy and translucent as a standard action, gaining DR 10/magic and the effects of greater invisibility for %1 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive. Like the natural invisibility universal monster ability (Bestiary 2 299), this ability is not subject to invisibility purge.|WizardLVL
